node.title: XR deficient window: affine-plane triple router
node.statement: After s-2 independent active-core cuts, three pairwise distinct-phi points in one selected defect block impose two conics on the residual affine plane. If the residual two-dimensional direction code has nonzero pairwise distinct projective evaluations on the triple, the conics have no common component and at most three affine intersections. Double counting gives (APT1)-(APT2). At the next unpaid dimensions this pays the printed ell=1 lower-x slices unless a restriction-degenerate triple flag occurs. The degeneracy mass remains open, so no critical status changes.
